input.content: Recovery/idempotency anti-pattern (Python save-recovery): keying the recovery-record lookup by `workspace` (scanning `store.recovery.values()` for a matching workspace) instead of by the caller-supplied `operation_id` causes distinct operation IDs on the same workspace to collide. A fresh operation finds a prior record, skips create+apply, and returns `{"ok": True, "operation_id": <param>}` — a false success that silently drops the new values. Spec required "a fresh operation ID must perform a fresh save, even for the same workspace." Fix: look up by operation_id (`store.recovery.get(operation_id)`), which also restores O(1) lookup vs an O(n) scan over an unbounded audit-retained recovery table.
